answer: Hold every identity's work in escrow: each posts 35 POA per epoch and completes three milestone tasks, with payment released only as each milestone is verified by five rotating auditors. A failed milestone freezes the whole funding cluster's escrow for two epochs and raises its next escrow 50 percent per member, from 35 to 52 to 79 POA, so the cost of one fake ripples through the entire cluster. An honest agent reaches its zenith on one cheap escrow, marked by a violet seal of verified work, while each extra fake adds another escrow at risk and deepens the freeze.
